//xterm: @xterm/* + @xterm/headless are pinned (exact, no ^) to the xterm 6.1 beta channel for ScreenDprMonitor + texture-atlas race fixes. Move all 8 in lockstep. Re-bump when xterm 6.1 ships stable, or to a newer beta if a relevant fix lands.
//xterm-webgl-trails: addon-webgl is INTENTIONALLY one build behind the other 7: 0.20.0-beta.292 does not exist (npm 404; the beta dist-tag is 0.20.0-beta.291). Do NOT 'restore lockstep' by bumping it to .292. Its peer @xterm/xterm ^6.1.0-beta.292 is satisfied by the others.
//xterm-atlas-fix: beta.291/292 carries the shared-texture-atlas fix (xterm.js #6042 pageLayoutVersion + #6055). CharAtlasCache is module-level, so N terminals share ONE TextureAtlas; before this fix, clearTexture() set no invalidation flag, so our correctAtlas() repacked the shared atlas and left every SIBLING renderer painting stale texcoords (garbage glyphs over correct layout until a resize). Never re-pin below it — src/client/xterm-atlas-fix.test.ts guards the shipped bundle.
